passive_desc: Increase Physical Penetration by 30%.\n\nUnique Passive - Malefic Energy: Increases Basic Attack range by 12%. When hitting a target, gains 10% Movement Speed for 0.5 seconds.
After casting an Ultimate, increase Movement Speed by 30% for 7.5 seconds. This effect has a 15 seconds cooldown.

Dealing damage to a target will reduce the Shield and HP Regen effects on them to 60% of normal for 3 seconds.\n\nUnique Passive - Punish: Increase damage by 8% against enemy heroes with higher extra HP.

Every 4 extra Physical Attack increases Hybrid Defense by 1, up to 50 (effect is halved if Main Role is not Fighter).\n\nUnique Passive - Lifeline: When taking damage that reduces HP below 30%, gains a (120*Hero Level) shield (increases with level) and 50% Movement Speed that rapidly decays over 3 seconds. This effect has a 60 seconds cooldown.

Dealing damage to the same enemy hero or creep 5 times in a row grants 50% extra Movement Speed that decays over 3 seconds (8 seconds cooldown).\n\nUnique Passive - Hunter: Increases damage against wild monsters.
